estonia.title: Franța acuză „provocări” după ce a ridicat de 11 ori într-o săptămână avioanele în zona Mării Baltice
estonia.description: Avioane de luptă franceze au fost ridicate de 11 ori în ultima săptămână în cadrul misiunii NATO de Poliție Aeriană în Țările Baltice, a declarat joi purtătorul de cuvânt al armatei franceze, care a descris aceste incidente drept un număr mai mare decât de obicei de „provocări”, notează Reuters. Misiunea are rolul de a proteja …

estonia.title: Charity dog walking event organizer: Pet owners increasingly having trouble
estonia.description: Pet owners are increasingly unable to care for their animals, either because of financial difficulties or because the animals have developed behavioral problems that owners are unable to manage, said animal welfare expert Geit Karurahu.

estonia.title: Estonia's Ministry of Finance to restrict access to beneficial owners data
estonia.description: Access to information about beneficial owners will be limited to authorities that need the information to carry out their duties and to individuals who can demonstrate a legitimate interest.

estonia.title: Labor Inspectorate softens stance on youth serving alcohol
estonia.description: The state Labor Inspectorate has come out in support of a government bill which would allow minors aged 16 and 17 to serve alcohol in restaurants and cafés.

estonia.title: EKRE leader downplays poll slump, targets strong showing ahead of Estonia vote
estonia.description: On Saturday, Estonia's right-conservative EKRE will elect a party chairman at its congress, and the only candidate is the party's current leader, Martin Helme. EKRE is not aiming to top Estonia's next election but hopes to secure a kingmaker role.

estonia.title: Estonia's art auction market defined by steady demand, several key artists
estonia.description: The 2026 spring art auction season in Estonia brought in nearly €3 million in sales, but the clearest signal was not headline prices — it was which artists continue to attract sustained buyer demand.

estonia.title: Pärnu kids brush up on water safety ahead of summer on the coast
estonia.description: Around 200 children took part in a water safety day in Pärnu, learning how to keep safe in and around water, respond in emergencies and even assist someone in distress.

estonia.title: Revamped Tour of Estonia cycling race starts Thursday
estonia.description: The 13th Tour of Estonia international cycle race gets underway on Thursday and brings some changes to the format.

estonia.title: Number of people on special care home waiting lists in Estonia doubles in 6 years
estonia.description: The Ministry of Social Affairs will request an additional €200 million over the next four years in this fall's state budget negotiations to create new special care service places and raise wages for employees working in special care homes, Secretary General Maarjo Mändmaa tells ERR.

estonia.title: Teachers of Estonia's state schools to earn more than their municipal colleagues
estonia.description: On Wednesday, the Ministry of Education and EHL signed a collective agreement under which the minimum salary for state school teachers will rise to €2,070. Other teachers, however, will continue to receive a minimum salary that is €100 lower.

estonia.title: Gallery: Bridge blown up in central Estonia gives EDF training skills
estonia.description: The Estonian Defense Forces (EDF) demolished an aging bridge in Järva County on Wednesday, Maaleht reported.

estonia.title: Social Democrat leader cleared after expense probe finds no offense
estonia.description: The Central Criminal Police closed an investigation into Riigikogu member Lauri Läänemets' expense allowances, clearing him without filing charges as no crime was found.

estonia.title: Swedish parliament approves prison leasing agreement with Estonia
estonia.description: The Swedish Riksdag ratified a prison leasing agreement with Estonia, an important milestone to ease Sweden's domestic overcrowding and preserve operations at Tartu Prison.

estonia.title: Estonia appoints new US ambassador
estonia.description: President Alar Karis has appointed Estonia's current ambassador to China, Hannes Hanso, as the next ambassador to the United States.

estonia.title: Soviet-era cafeteria exhibit serves up taste of the past near Tartu
estonia.description: A new exhibit at a museum just outside Tartu lets visitors step inside a recreated Soviet-era cafeteria, exploring everyday dining culture from decades past.

estonia.title: Birdwatcher snaps rare sighting of vulture in western Estonia
estonia.description: A rare vulture was spotted in western Estonia this week, Lääne Elu reported.

estonia.title: 'Schengen door needs closing more tightly:' 11 countries call for Russian visa restrictions
estonia.description: Estonia and 10 European countries are pushing for the European Union to reduce Russian access to the Schengen Area ahead of the upcoming summer.

estonia.title: Estonia police expand 'cool-down stops' as alternative to speeding fines
estonia.description: Police in Estonia are increasing the use of "cool-down stops," offering some speeding drivers a 45-minute break instead of a fine, with about 90 such enforcement operations planned nationwide.

estonia.title: Institutional support remains modest ahead of Saturday's Baltic Pride march in Tallinn
estonia.description: The Baltic Pride 2026 March takes place in Tallinn this Saturday, but attendance by representatives of official organizations and institutions is expected to be quite light.

estonia.title: Parempoolsed: Tallinn coalition mirroring Reform's state-level policy
estonia.description: The Center Party's and Isamaa's actions in Tallinn are an exact copy of the Reform Party's pattern at the national level, as the policies of all three parties have been reduced to blanket subsidies and handing out free things, Parempoolsed leader Lavly Perling said.

estonia.title: Rescue Board planning €1.3 million worth of crisis preparedness campaigns
estonia.description: The Estonian Rescue Board plans to spend €1.3 million over the next two years on campaigns aimed at improving people's crisis preparedness and encouraging safe, sustainable behavior related to water and fire safety.

estonia.title: Erik Gamzejev: The Narva power split as the consequence of indifferent voters
estonia.description: As Narva's political power struggle descends into a surreal standoff between rival administrations, the city's dual-power crisis is exposing deeper problems in local democracy, voter engagement and political accountability, writes Erik Gamzejev.

estonia.title: The focus of this year's Tallinn Architecture Biennale is Linnahall
estonia.description: The eighth Tallinn Architecture Biennale will take place from September 9 to November 30. In addition to the curated main program, the festival also features a satellite program that extends beyond Tallinn to Tartu and Kuressaare.

estonia.title: Rally Estonia organizers to make debut behind the wheel
estonia.description: WRC Delfi Rally Estonia returns to the roads and tracks of South Estonia in July.

estonia.title: Estonia has no clarity on rotating US unit, minister says
estonia.description: Estonia has no clarity on future U.S. troop rotations, Minister of Defense Hanno Pevkur (Reform) said on Wednesday, after it was reported that Lithuania does not know when its American forces will be replaced.

estonia.title: Tallinn scraps hospital design contract after spending €3 million
estonia.description: Design work on the planned Lasnamäe medical campus has been terminated at a cost of almost €3 million, with a lack of clear funding from the state cited as the reason.

estonia.title: Security exercise taking place at Estonian Public Broadcasting on Thursday
estonia.description: An attack drill will take place today (Thursday, June 4) at Estonian Public Broadcasting's (ERR) Uudistemaja news building, as part of the large-scale security exercise Ilves 2026.

estonia.title: Estonian police withhold location of previously missing child from mother
estonia.description: Police on Tuesday located a French father and his 1-year-old child who had left the child's mother on May 29 and had been the subject of a nationwide search. However, according to the child's mother, the police are refusing to disclose the child's location at the father's request.

estonia.title: Bill would double foreign worker quota during economic growth
estonia.description: Estonia could allow up to 2,600 foreign workers a year to fill labor shortages during periods of growth, under proposed changes to the country's immigration law.

estonia.title: Algae cleared from Tartu's Anne Canal ahead of summer swimming season
estonia.description: A large amount of ugly but harmless algae was removed from Tartu's Anne Canal this week, as summer finally arrived in Estonia.

estonia.title: Marja-Liisa Veiser: We should not be ashamed of the Estonian flag
estonia.description: We have reason to be proud of our flag, our country and our freedom, and for that reason Tallinn is doing the right thing by erecting a large flagpole on Pirita tee, writes Marja-Liisa Veiser.

estonia.title: Construction of Defense Force's Narva base will start this year
estonia.description: The Defense Force's new base in Narva, on Estonia's eastern border with Russia, will start to be built later this year, said Minister of Defense Hanno Pevkur (Reform) during a visit to Ida-Viru County.

estonia.title: Interior Minister: currently impossible to speed up border crossing in Narva
estonia.description: Estonia's Minister of the Interior, Igor Taro (Eesti 200), said in response to an inquiry in Riigikogu that long queues at the Narva border crossing are directly linked to Russia's war against Ukraine and intensified customs inspections.

estonia.title: Young Estonian artists present personal narratives through art
estonia.description: The exhibition "Youth Narratives" at Kadriorg Gallery in Tallinn presents fresh perspectives on contemporary life through the work of emerging artists.

estonia.title: Mai Narva still in top 10 in European chess championships with 3 games left
estonia.description: Estonian chess player Mai Narva has taken her second win at the ongoing European Women's Chess Championship (EWCC) in Batumi, Georgia, beating Nadya Toncheva (Bulgaria).

estonia.title: Misuse of red flares triggers costly, unnecessary sea rescues
estonia.description: Police receive reports year after year of red signal flares being seen at sea or in coastal areas. In most cases no one actually needs help, and rescue services have to spend time and manpower responding unnecessarily.

estonia.title: Study: Dependence on foreign links could paralyze Estonian financial sector
estonia.description: Known as an e-state, Estonia's digital backbone relies heavily on international connections, meaning that damage to undersea cables in the Baltic Sea could disrupt even everyday banking services overnight. According to a master's thesis defended at TalTech, financial institutions should develop independent local payment solutions to use in the event of a communications crisis.

estonia.title: 100s of new ammunition depots being built across Estonia
estonia.description: Hundreds of ammunition storage facilities are being built across the country as Estonia looks to boost its capabilities in one of the largest national defense projects to date, Elmar Vaher, director of the Estonian Center for Defense Investments, said on Wednesday.

estonia.title: €1.75 billion in last year's state budget was unspent
estonia.description: Of last year's €19.5 billion state budget, nine percent — €1.75 billion — remained unused. This is several hundred million euros less than the €2.1 billion recorded the year before.

estonia.title: Former ambassador: Resignation from the Foreign Ministry did not reflect my wishes
estonia.description: Former Estonian Ambassador to Kazakhstan Jaap Ora said that his dismissal from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs was legally invalid and did not reflect his wishes. He added that the ministry's actions are unacceptable.

estonia.title: Ratings: SDE lose support, Isamaa widen lead over Center Party
estonia.description: The opposition Social Democrats (SDE) have seen a slight fall in support over the past week, according to a recent poll.

estonia.title: Mark Lajal gets grass court season off to winning start in Birmingham
estonia.description: Estonia's top tennis player Mark Lajal beat Switzerland's number 2 Leandro Riedi in straight sets at the ATP Challenger 125 tournament in Birmingham, England.

estonia.title: Government observes 'one in, one out' anti-bureaucracy rule in a third of new bills
estonia.description: The government's new "one in, one out" rule has prompted ministries to take administrative burden more seriously, with some new requirements being delayed or dropped altogether and hundreds of outdated regulations identified for repeal or simplification, officials say.

estonia.title: Gallery: Estonia's largest public timber building set for fall 2026 completion
estonia.description: The new Nature House in Tallinn, right next to the Seaplane Harbour will be completed this year, and the Natural History Museum will open during 2027.

estonia.title: 6 people charged in Valga murder case
estonia.description: Prosecutors have sent to court a criminal case in which six people are charged with beating and murdering a man in Valga, South Estonia, in April this year.

estonia.title: Air threat alert: No drones detected in Estonia's airspace, EDF says
estonia.description: No drones reached Estonian territory on Wednesday, the Estonian Defense Forces (EDF) have said, after several EE-Alarms were issued in the early morning following Ukraine's attacks on Russia.

estonia.title: Division Commander: Drones are only a fraction of what Estonian defense must build
estonia.description: Developing drone capabilities is just a small part of what the defense sector needs, said Maj. Gen. Indrek Sirel, commander of the Estonian Defence Forces Division, about the recent Spring Storm exercise in Estonia.

estonia.title: A third of Tallinn schools want to start the school day before 9 a.m.
estonia.description: As of early June, nearly 20 Tallinn municipal schools want to start the school day earlier in the coming academic year than permitted under a Ministry of Education regulation requiring classes to begin at 9 a.m. or later.

latvia.title: Financial Times: Az Egyesült Államok azt mérlegeli, telepítsen-e még több európai NATO-tagállamba nukleáris fegyvereket
latvia.description: Nehéz lekövetni az Egyesült Államok európai katonai jelenlétével kapcsolatos irányváltásait. Legutóbb Trump arról beszélt, csökkenti az Európában állomásoztatott katonák számát, az FT forrásai szerint az emiatti feszültségeket csökkentenék a nukleáris fegyverek telepítésével.

latvia.title: Háromszáz méteren szakadt le a felsővezeték a miskolci vasútvonalon
latvia.description: Vámosgyörk és Ludas között csak egy vágányon közlekedhetnek a vonatok, Vámosgyörk és Füzesabony közt pedig a személyvonatok ideiglenesen nem járnak.

latvia.title: „Ferrari a levegőben” – élőben néztük meg, mit tudnak az ukrán elfogódrónok, amikért a fél világ sorban áll
latvia.description: Ukrajna feltalálta a csapásmérő drónok ellenszerét, rémálmot hozva ezzel a háborús kiadásokat számoló orosz könyvelőknek. Ilyen technológiát és tudást akar most vásárolni az Öböl-monarchiáktól a NATO-ig mindenki.

latvia.title: „A mai nap fő témája a tiszás energiaterv, ez az elnevezés lécci MINDENHOL” – írják az MTVA kiszivárgott belső levelezésében
latvia.description: Magyar Péter Papp Dániel és Altorjai Anita vezérigazgatók távozását követeli.

latvia.title: Körbevonatoztam az országot, másfél napig tartott
latvia.description: Mire elég 33 óra a magyar vasúton? 14 megyére, 1400 kilométerre és 15 átszállásra. Bejártam az országot, Soprontól Kötegyánig és Barcstól Szerencsig.

latvia.title: Mától újra járnak a vonatok Veszprém és Ajka között
latvia.description: A szakaszt még 2024 decemberében zárta le a MÁV, miután a 2018-ban felújított pályát egy 150 méteres szakaszon alámosta a víz.

latvia.title: A választás utánra halasztotta a Corvinus rektora az orosz dezinformációról szóló konferenciát, egy szenátor lemondott, Rácz András eljön az egyetemről a döntés miatt
latvia.description: A belga rektor nem merte bevállalni a tudományos konferenciát a választás előtt, mert már a Bucsával kapcsolatos orosz hazugságok kutatása is politikai tevékenység lehet. Rácz felmondott.

latvia.title: Tanács Zoltán leváltotta a Digitális Magyarország Ügynökség vezérigazgatóját
latvia.description: Vezérigazgatót cserélt a Digitális Magyarország Ügynökség (DMÜ) élén Tanács Zoltán tudományos és technológiai miniszter – tudta meg a Telex. Both András távozó vezérigazgató megerősítette, hogy csütör...

latvia.title: Magyar Péter: Az orosz dróntámadás ismét rávilágít arra, hogy Európa és a NATO egysége ma fontosabb, mint eddig bármikor
latvia.description: Románia délkeleti részén talált el egy orosz drón egy tízemeletes lakóházat.

latvia.title: Magyar találkozott a NATO főtitkárával és egy macskával, és megismételte, hogy nem küldünk fegyvert Ukrajnába
latvia.description: Se fegyvert, se harci eszközöket. A macska De Wever belga miniszterelnöké.

latvia.title: Járattörlések miatt kért bocsánatot a magyaroktól a fapados légitársaság
latvia.description: A pórul járt utasok két lehetőség közül választhatnak.

latvia.title: Szintet lép a katonai készültség: csapásmérő helikoptereket vezényelnek az orosz határ közelébe
latvia.description: Csehország története során először telepít AH-1Z Viper harci helikoptereket külföldi hadműveleti területre. A gépek júniustól Lengyelországban erősítik majd a NATO keleti szárnyának légtérvédelmét, felváltva a korábban ott állomásozó UH-1Y Venom helikoptereket - írta az Army Recognition .

latvia.title: Félelmetes dróngyilkos fegyverek érkeznek a szomszédos országba, hatalmas üzletet kötött a német óriás
latvia.description: Románia egy 5,7 milliárd euró értékű szerződést írt alá a Rheinmetall vállalattal, amelynek keretében többek között Lynx alvázra szerelt Skyranger légvédelmi rendszereket szerez be. Ez a megállapodás a NATO fekete-tengeri szárnyának egyik legjelentősebb védelmi beszerzése, amely célzottan a drónok és az alacsony magasságban jelentkező légi fenyegetések elleni védelmi képességeket hivatott megerősíteni - számolt be az Army Recognition .

latvia.title: Ostrý test na Lešti: Cvičenie Strong Lineage 26 ukázalo silu NATO na východnom krídle
latvia.description: Súčasťou cvičenia je aj doplnenie nasadených síl a prostriedkov presunom z Českej republiky a Španielska.

latvia.title: Moskva testuje nervy NATO. Rusko si podľa štúdie vybralo jeden kľúčový región
latvia.description: Moskva rozohrala podľa štúdie nebezpečnú hru.

latvia.title: Prezident Pavel se ohlásil na pondělní jednání vlády
latvia.description: Prezident Petr Pavel zamíří v pondělí do Strakovy akademie na jednání vlády premiéra Andreje Babiše (ANO). Koaliční kabinet by mohl mimo jiné probírat složení české delegace, která zamíří na červencový summit NATO v turecké Ankaře. Pavel chce být její součástí, Babiš s jeho oficiální účastí zatím nepočítá, navíc chce věc podle informací Novinek definitivně rozseknout až 22. června.

latvia.title: Ukrajina zasáhla ropný terminál a korvetu v Petrohradu, kde začíná fórum s účastí Putina
latvia.description: Desítky ukrajinských dronů zaútočily na ruskou Leningradskou oblast a Petrohrad. Podle tamních úřadů je poškozená infrastruktura a zraněno několik lidí. Telegramové kanály i Kyjev uvedly, že zasažen byl ropný terminál a základna ruského Baltského loďstva. Ve městě ve středu začíná Petrohradské mezinárodní ekonomické fórum (SPIEF), na kterém má promluvit ruský diktátor Vladimir Putin. Ruské útoky na Ukrajinu mezitím zabily několik lidí, desítky zranily. Do Kyjeva ve středu přijel generální tajemník NATO Mark Rutte.

latvia.title: Maria Zaharova spune că Aliații vor să preia controlul Balcanilor: „NATO încearcă să sufoce Serbia ca un boa constrictor”
latvia.description: Rusia a acuzat joi NATO că strânge Serbia „ca un boa constrictor”, citând un exerciţiu militar comun care are loc acolo ca dovadă a unei încercări de a subjuga ţara din partea alianţei militare occidentale, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Avertismentul dur al șefului NATO, Mark Rutte, către tinerii ruși care vor să lupte în Ucraina: „Veți fi lăsați să muriți în noroi”
latvia.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a transmis un mesaj tinerilor ruși, spunând că, dacă vor fi răniți în Ucraina, vor fi „lăsați să sufere în noroi și să moară”.

latvia.title: Avertismentul lansat de un general leton: Rusia ar putea invada țările membre NATO până la sfârșitul anului 2028
latvia.description: Rusia a dobândit un avantaj în domeniul războiului cu drone față de țările NATO și ar putea încerca să profite de o „fereastră de oportunitate” până la sfârșitul anului 2028 pentru a invada statele baltice, a avertizat șeful armatei letone, relatează Financial Times.

latvia.title: „Rusia devine tot mai disperată”, spune Mark Rutte
latvia.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a declarat miercuri, în timpul unei vizite la Kiev, că Rusia este „tot mai disperată”, în timp ce Ucraina „continuă să reziste ferm” la mai bine de patru ani de la începerea invaziei ruseşti, relatează AFP și Agerpres.

latvia.title: SUA cer Europei și Canadei să suplimenteze avioanele, dronele și navele militare pe măsură ce își reduc contribuția la NATO
latvia.description: Statele Unite aşteaptă de la aliaţii europeni din NATO şi de la Canada să îşi crească rapid numărul de aparate de zbor cu şi fără pilot şi de nave militare cu care vor contribui la planurile de apărare ale Alianţei, pe măsură ce Washingtonul îşi retrage capacităţile în aceste domenii, a indicat miercuri generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul suprem al Forţelor aliate din Europa (SACEUR), transmite Reuters.

latvia.title: Zelenski anunță că Ucraina va trimite experți antidrone în România și statele baltice
latvia.description: Preşedintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski a anunţat miercuri, la o conferinţă de presă comună la Kiev cu secretarul general al NATO Mark Rutte, că Ucraina va trimite grupuri de experţi în apărare aeriană antidrone în România şi în statele baltice pentru a le ajuta să îşi protejeze teritoriul în faţa incursiunilor dronelor folosite în războiul ruso-ucrainean.

latvia.title: Mark Rutte, vizită-surpriză la Kiev: „Un gest de solidaritate şi de sprijin din partea Alianţei față de țara noastră”
latvia.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a sosit miercuri la Kiev pentru o vizită surpriză, a anunţat compania feroviară ucraineană Ukrzaliznytsia, transmit AFP şi Reuters.

latvia.title: Criza iraniană schimbă calculele de securitate: „NATO devine tot mai relevantă”, spune fostul consilier al lui Trump
latvia.description: NATO devine din ce în ce mai importantă pe măsură ce Europa se confruntă cu riscuri de securitate crescânde din partea Iranului, a declarat fostul consilier pentru securitate națională al SUA, John Bolton, într-un interviu acordat TVP World. El a avertizat că activitățile Iranului și capacitățile sale în materie de rachete ar putea amenința direct Europa și nu ar trebui considerate doar o preocupare a SUA. Bolton a criticat, de asemenea, lipsa de coordonare a Washingtonului cu aliații și a afirmat că incertitudinea privind strategia SUA în Orientul Mijlociu ar putea avea implicații mai ample pentru securitatea globală, inclusiv pentru Ucraina.

latvia.title: USR: Coaliţia dintre PSD şi extremiştii proruşi, vot împotriva includerii magistraților în categoria avertizorilor de integritate
latvia.description: Reprezentanţii USR acuză că senatorii PSD şi partidelor „extremiste proruse” au votat împotriva includerii judecătorilor şi procurorilor în categoria avertizorilor de integritate. „Un sistem în care chiar cei din interior nu sunt protejaţi atunci când semnalează nereguli transmite un mesaj negativ societăţii: că transparenţa şi responsabilitatea nu sunt pe deplin asumate. Se menţine o ambiguitate juridică periculoasă”, afirmă senatorul USR Simona Spătaru.

latvia.title: Senatul a respins alegerea primarilor în două tururi. AUR și USR au votat pentru, PSD și PNL au fost împotriva proiectului
latvia.description: Senatul a respins, marți, proiectul de lege inițiat de parlamentari AUR care prevedea revenirea la alegerea primarilor și a președinților de consilii județene în două tururi de scrutin. Inițiativa a fost susținută de senatorii AUR, Pace-Întâi România și USR, însă a fost respinsă de PSD, PNL și UDMR, astfel că nu a întrunit numărul necesar de voturi pentru a fi adoptată.

latvia.title: Șoșoacă apără Rusia în cazul dronei de la Galați, în direct la televiziunea Kremlinului: „Ne puteți ataca și azi, și mâine”
latvia.description: Preșdinta S.O.S România, Diana Șoșoacă, a avut o intervenție la televiziunea Russia Today, după ce o dronă rusească a lovit un bloc din Galați, în timpul căreia a acuzat NATO și Uniunea Europeană că vor să forțeze țara noastră să atace Rusia. Mai mult, aceasta ia apărarea Kremlinului, afirmând că cel mai probabil Ucraina e de vină pentru incident.

latvia.title: „Ca un boa constrictor”. Rusia critică exercițiul militar din Serbia la care participă opt țări NATO, printre care și România
latvia.description: Purtătoarea de cuvânt a Ministerului de externe al Rusiei, Maria Zaharova, a criticat exercițiul anual „Platinum Wolf” din Serbia, acuzând NATO că încearcă să subjuge Serbia „ca un boa constrictor”, a transmis Reuters. Reprezentanta diplomației ruse susține că NATO vrea să preia controlul asupra Balcanilor și să îndepărteze Serbia de Rusia. „Își încolăcesc iubirea în …

latvia.title: Franța acuză „provocări” după ce a ridicat de 11 ori într-o săptămână avioanele în zona Mării Baltice
latvia.description: Avioane de luptă franceze au fost ridicate de 11 ori în ultima săptămână în cadrul misiunii NATO de Poliție Aeriană în Țările Baltice, a declarat joi purtătorul de cuvânt al armatei franceze, care a descris aceste incidente drept un număr mai mare decât de obicei de „provocări”, notează Reuters. Misiunea are rolul de a proteja …

latvia.title: Rootsi kohus käskis arestida Vene varilaevastiku aluse
latvia.description: Rootsi kohus otsustas täna Ukraina palve järel arestida sanktsioonide alla kuuluva Vene varilaevastiku aluse Caffa, vahendab Kyiv Independent.

latvia.title: Rīga Zoo aims to build the Himalayas in Latvia
latvia.description: While Latvia may notably lack any actual mountains of its own, that's not preventing Rīga Zoo from ambitious plans to construct the Himalayas on the outskirts of the capital city.

latvia.title: Latvia raises a billion euros on financial markets
latvia.description: Latvia's State Treasury (Valsts Kase, VK) said on Thursday that it has raised a billion euros on the international financial markets with a bond issue.

latvia.title: Latvian industrial production up 7.0 % in April
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau data (calendar adjusted at constant prices) published on June 4th show that in April 2026 Latvia's industrial production output increased by 7.0 % year-on-year.

latvia.title: About 9% of Latvian students leave school early
latvia.description: In 2025, the share of early school leavers (young people aged 18-24 leaving early from education and training) in the EU was 9.1%, almost meeting the EU-level target of 9.0% for 2030, according to Eruostat data published on June 4th.

latvia.title: Baltic parliamentarians will enjoy Friday in Liepāja
latvia.description: On Friday, June 5th, at a joint meeting of the Baltic Assembly (BA) Committees on Natural Resources and Environment and on Health, Welfare and Family Affairs, parliamentarians from Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania will seek solutions for a more comprehensive harmonisation of climate and health policies in the Baltic States, as well as discuss the implementation of joint measures to mitigate the impact of climate change on human health.

latvia.title: Ombudsman says Latvia's guardianship court needs reform
latvia.description: Ombudsman Karina Palkova is calling for an immediate reform of the guardianship court, or so-called Orphans' court, system, according to the Ombudsman’s Office.

latvia.title: You can file road accident reports on WhatsApp in Latvia
latvia.description: The fastest and easiest way to report an accident with no injuries and involving only two cars is to file a joint accident report. This can be done very conveniently on the "WhatsApp" platform, as noted by traffic expert Oskars Irbītis and Agris Daukste, head of the Information Technology (IT) department at the Latvian Motor Insurers’ Bureau, on the Latvian Radio programme "How to Live Better."

latvia.title: Latvian Radio probes allegations of bullying on Rail Baltica project
latvia.description: In recent years, the State Labour Inspectorate (VDI) has been receiving an increasing number of complaints about bullying and aggressive management in state-owned companies. The institution has received such complaints about "Eiropas Dzelzceļa līnījas" (European Railway Lines/EDzL), the capital company responsible for the implementation of the multi-billion-euro "Rail Baltica" project in Latvia, and part of the overall 'RB Rail' management structure for the project.

latvia.title: What do free trade deals with India, South America and Australia mean for Latvia?
latvia.description: Does anyone know or remember the exact Trump tariffs vis-à-vis the European Union? I don’t, I shall admit. But given all direct impact on trade with the US (smaller) and the indirect impact on trade (also smaller) via confusion and hesitation, postponement of investment etc., it is nice to see that the EU (some 450 million people) has managed free trade deals with three very big players.

latvia.title: Latvia will start exchanging laboratory data with other EU states
latvia.description: The Latvian Digital Health Centre, in cooperation with the National Health Service, is implementing the project “Exchange of laboratory data of Latvian patients”, the aim of which is to launch a new E-health service; the cross-border exchange of laboratory test results within the European Union (EU).

latvia.title: Saeima seat switcheroo as new government starts work
latvia.description: With the confirmation of the government led by Andris Kulbergs (United List), the composition of the 14th Saeima is also changing – several former ministers have returned to work in parliament, and some new members fill the seats of those who have become ministers.

latvia.title: New think-tank urges: be more Baltic
latvia.description: With the slogan "Be More Baltic", the "Baltic International Security Centre" (BISC) think-tank was unveiled in Brussels on Wednesday, June 3, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Finance Minister sceptical about continuing diesel tax incentive
latvia.description: The government will still have to assess whether to maintain the reduced excise tax rate on diesel fuel after June 30, as its price has now stabilised, Finance Minister Māris Kučinskis (United List) said in an interview with Latvian Radio on June 4.

latvia.title: Latvia's trains could run slightly faster in the future
latvia.description: Electric trains between Rīga and Jelgava may be able to travel at speeds of up to 140 kilometres per hour (km/h) in the future. That is 20 km/h faster than the current speed, according to Latvian Railways, Latvian Radio reported on June 4.

latvia.title: Reminder: don't try to 'rescue' baby animals
latvia.description: With the current season in full swing, people are increasingly likely to encounter baby wild animals; therefore, the Nature Conservation Agency (DAP) has urged the public not to interfere with the animals’ daily lives and not to touch the young, even if they appear to have been abandoned.

latvia.title: LSM gets new visual identity
latvia.description: Latvian Public Media (LSM) is gradually introducing a unified brand and visual identity, as you have likely noticed at the top of our page.

latvia.title: Latvian climbers' bodies recovered from Denali
latvia.description: In Alaska, United States, the bodies of three Latvian climbers who died last week – Inese Pučeka, Vija Olte, and Renārs Kunigs-Salaks – were brought down from Denali or Mount McKinley, North America’s highest mountain, on Thursday. This has also been confirmed by the Latvian Embassy in the U.S.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia and Finland to team up on new military vehicle
latvia.description: Latvian and Finnish defence institutions have agreed to jointly begin work on the development of a new military vehicle system.

latvia.title: Free public transport, extra departures during Daugavpils city festival
latvia.description: From June 5 to 7, Latvia's second-largest city, Daugavpils, will celebrate its 751st birthday. In order for city residents and guests to get to the event venues faster and more conveniently, additional public transport services will be provided from June 5 to 7 and on June 6 and 7, public transport will be free for everyone.

latvia.title: Latvian ammo maker Ammunity names new CEO
latvia.description: Changes have been made in the management of Latvian ammunition manufacturer SIA Ammunity, it has been announced.

latvia.title: So far, so good, says President of new Latvian government's first week
latvia.description: Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs said on June 3rd he was happy with the initial signs from the new four-party coalition government headed by Andris Kulbergs (United List).

latvia.title: Baltics, Nordics, USA discuss NATO summit
latvia.description: On 1–2 June 2026, the regular meeting of the E-PINE (Enhanced Partnership in Northern Europe) format took place in Tallinn and Narva, Estonia, bringing together representatives of the Baltic States, the Nordic countries, and the United States of America (USA). Latvia was represented by Juris Poikāns, Ambassador-at-Large, according to a release from the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

latvia.title: Sexual predator doctor sentenced to 13 years in prison
latvia.description: The Riga District Court has found Dr Jevgēnijs Ņikiforenko guilty of sexual assault against several patients and sentenced him to 13 years in prison, LSM.lv and Latvian Television report on June 3.

latvia.title: Latvian Postal Service has its eye on new cars
latvia.description: The state-owned company Latvijas Pasts (Latvian Postal Service) will purchase 40 new vehicles for 1.3 million euros, the company announced on June 3.

latvia.title: Latvia's foreign visitor numbers down -7.5% in first quarter
latvia.description: Amid fears that drone alerts and international tensions are depressing tourist numbers in the Baltic states, the latest Eurostat figures show a mixed picture.

latvia.title: Latvia-founded Prime Prometics posts standout results
latvia.description: Prime Prometics, a company in the pro-age beauty segment founded by a Latvian, continued its rapid growth in 2025, surpassing €101 million in annual revenue for the first time in the company’s history, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: More rain expected in second half of week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected more frequently in Latvia during the second half of the week, but the weather will remain warm.

latvia.title: Urgent care unit to be closed in Latvian northern town Valka
latvia.description: A shortage of medical staff has forced Vidzeme Hospital to decide to close the emergency medical care centre in Valka on the Estonian border, Latvian Radio reports on June 3.

latvia.title: Are Latvians drinking less? Short answer is we don't know
latvia.description: August marks one year since alcohol sales restrictions went into effect, including shorter hours for selling alcoholic beverages and limits on advertising. Has this changed any habits? Latvian Radio attempted to find out on June 3.

latvia.title: Wednesday will be warm with possible thunderstorms in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that the weather in Latvia will be warm on Wednesday, with rain and thunderstorms expected in parts of Vidzeme.

latvia.title: Stinky business shut down in Baldone, Latvia
latvia.description: For years, residents of Baldone have had to put up with a very unpleasant odour caused by a quail farm set up on a neighbour’s property. After receiving numerous complaints, the local government has decided to prohibit the business owner from operating at this location in the future, Zemgale Regional Television reported on June 2.

latvia.title: New hybrid wind energy park in Līvāni, Latvia
latvia.description: On Tuesday, June 2, the first hybrid energy park in Latvia, developed by renewable energy company "Vindr," was officially opened in Līvāni municipality.

lithuania.description: US President Donald Trump's Anti-Weaponisation Fund, launched to compensate individuals who believe they were subjected to politically motivated investigations, is being questioned by senators in his own party.

lithuania.description: Azzal mentegetőztek, hogy sok hamis foglalást kapnak, és ez okozott frusztrációt, amikor választ írtak, mert azt hitték, egy újabb hamis foglalással van dolguk.

lithuania.title: „Tevékenysége nem kívánatos egy alkotmányos demokráciában” – benyújtották a Szuverenitásvédelmi Hivatalt megszüntető törvényjavaslatot
lithuania.description: A javaslat szerint a hivatal „egyáltalán nem védte Magyarország szuverenitását, ezzel szemben elsődleges szerepet játszott az autokratikus hatalomgyakorlás támogatásában”.

lithuania.title: Financial Times: Az Egyesült Államok azt mérlegeli, telepítsen-e még több európai NATO-tagállamba nukleáris fegyvereket
lithuania.description: Nehéz lekövetni az Egyesült Államok európai katonai jelenlétével kapcsolatos irányváltásait. Legutóbb Trump arról beszélt, csökkenti az Európában állomásoztatott katonák számát, az FT forrásai szerint az emiatti feszültségeket csökkentenék a nukleáris fegyverek telepítésével.

lithuania.title: Háromszáz méteren szakadt le a felsővezeték a miskolci vasútvonalon
lithuania.description: Vámosgyörk és Ludas között csak egy vágányon közlekedhetnek a vonatok, Vámosgyörk és Füzesabony közt pedig a személyvonatok ideiglenesen nem járnak.

lithuania.title: „Ferrari a levegőben” – élőben néztük meg, mit tudnak az ukrán elfogódrónok, amikért a fél világ sorban áll
lithuania.description: Ukrajna feltalálta a csapásmérő drónok ellenszerét, rémálmot hozva ezzel a háborús kiadásokat számoló orosz könyvelőknek. Ilyen technológiát és tudást akar most vásárolni az Öböl-monarchiáktól a NATO-ig mindenki.

lithuania.title: Körbevonatoztam az országot, másfél napig tartott
lithuania.description: Mire elég 33 óra a magyar vasúton? 14 megyére, 1400 kilométerre és 15 átszállásra. Bejártam az országot, Soprontól Kötegyánig és Barcstól Szerencsig.

lithuania.title: Mától újra járnak a vonatok Veszprém és Ajka között
lithuania.description: A szakaszt még 2024 decemberében zárta le a MÁV, miután a 2018-ban felújított pályát egy 150 méteres szakaszon alámosta a víz.

lithuania.title: A választás utánra halasztotta a Corvinus rektora az orosz dezinformációról szóló konferenciát, egy szenátor lemondott, Rácz András eljön az egyetemről a döntés miatt
lithuania.description: A belga rektor nem merte bevállalni a tudományos konferenciát a választás előtt, mert már a Bucsával kapcsolatos orosz hazugságok kutatása is politikai tevékenység lehet. Rácz felmondott.

lithuania.title: Magyar Péter: Az orosz dróntámadás ismét rávilágít arra, hogy Európa és a NATO egysége ma fontosabb, mint eddig bármikor
lithuania.description: Románia délkeleti részén talált el egy orosz drón egy tízemeletes lakóházat.

lithuania.title: Magyar találkozott a NATO főtitkárával és egy macskával, és megismételte, hogy nem küldünk fegyvert Ukrajnába
lithuania.description: Se fegyvert, se harci eszközöket. A macska De Wever belga miniszterelnöké.

lithuania.title: Járattörlések miatt kért bocsánatot a magyaroktól a fapados légitársaság
lithuania.description: A pórul járt utasok két lehetőség közül választhatnak.

lithuania.title: Szintet lép a katonai készültség: csapásmérő helikoptereket vezényelnek az orosz határ közelébe
lithuania.description: Csehország története során először telepít AH-1Z Viper harci helikoptereket külföldi hadműveleti területre. A gépek júniustól Lengyelországban erősítik majd a NATO keleti szárnyának légtérvédelmét, felváltva a korábban ott állomásozó UH-1Y Venom helikoptereket - írta az Army Recognition .

lithuania.title: Félelmetes dróngyilkos fegyverek érkeznek a szomszédos országba, hatalmas üzletet kötött a német óriás
lithuania.description: Románia egy 5,7 milliárd euró értékű szerződést írt alá a Rheinmetall vállalattal, amelynek keretében többek között Lynx alvázra szerelt Skyranger légvédelmi rendszereket szerez be. Ez a megállapodás a NATO fekete-tengeri szárnyának egyik legjelentősebb védelmi beszerzése, amely célzottan a drónok és az alacsony magasságban jelentkező légi fenyegetések elleni védelmi képességeket hivatott megerősíteni - számolt be az Army Recognition .

lithuania.title: Ostrý test na Lešti: Cvičenie Strong Lineage 26 ukázalo silu NATO na východnom krídle
lithuania.description: Súčasťou cvičenia je aj doplnenie nasadených síl a prostriedkov presunom z Českej republiky a Španielska.

lithuania.title: Moskva testuje nervy NATO. Rusko si podľa štúdie vybralo jeden kľúčový región
lithuania.description: Moskva rozohrala podľa štúdie nebezpečnú hru.

lithuania.title: Prezident Pavel se ohlásil na pondělní jednání vlády
lithuania.description: Prezident Petr Pavel zamíří v pondělí do Strakovy akademie na jednání vlády premiéra Andreje Babiše (ANO). Koaliční kabinet by mohl mimo jiné probírat složení české delegace, která zamíří na červencový summit NATO v turecké Ankaře. Pavel chce být její součástí, Babiš s jeho oficiální účastí zatím nepočítá, navíc chce věc podle informací Novinek definitivně rozseknout až 22. června.

lithuania.title: Ukrajina zasáhla ropný terminál a korvetu v Petrohradu, kde začíná fórum s účastí Putina
lithuania.description: Desítky ukrajinských dronů zaútočily na ruskou Leningradskou oblast a Petrohrad. Podle tamních úřadů je poškozená infrastruktura a zraněno několik lidí. Telegramové kanály i Kyjev uvedly, že zasažen byl ropný terminál a základna ruského Baltského loďstva. Ve městě ve středu začíná Petrohradské mezinárodní ekonomické fórum (SPIEF), na kterém má promluvit ruský diktátor Vladimir Putin. Ruské útoky na Ukrajinu mezitím zabily několik lidí, desítky zranily. Do Kyjeva ve středu přijel generální tajemník NATO Mark Rutte.

lithuania.title: Maria Zaharova spune că Aliații vor să preia controlul Balcanilor: „NATO încearcă să sufoce Serbia ca un boa constrictor”
lithuania.description: Rusia a acuzat joi NATO că strânge Serbia „ca un boa constrictor”, citând un exerciţiu militar comun care are loc acolo ca dovadă a unei încercări de a subjuga ţara din partea alianţei militare occidentale, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Avertismentul dur al șefului NATO, Mark Rutte, către tinerii ruși care vor să lupte în Ucraina: „Veți fi lăsați să muriți în noroi”
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a transmis un mesaj tinerilor ruși, spunând că, dacă vor fi răniți în Ucraina, vor fi „lăsați să sufere în noroi și să moară”.

lithuania.title: Avertismentul lansat de un general leton: Rusia ar putea invada țările membre NATO până la sfârșitul anului 2028
lithuania.description: Rusia a dobândit un avantaj în domeniul războiului cu drone față de țările NATO și ar putea încerca să profite de o „fereastră de oportunitate” până la sfârșitul anului 2028 pentru a invada statele baltice, a avertizat șeful armatei letone, relatează Financial Times.

lithuania.title: „Rusia devine tot mai disperată”, spune Mark Rutte
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a declarat miercuri, în timpul unei vizite la Kiev, că Rusia este „tot mai disperată”, în timp ce Ucraina „continuă să reziste ferm” la mai bine de patru ani de la începerea invaziei ruseşti, relatează AFP și Agerpres.

lithuania.title: SUA cer Europei și Canadei să suplimenteze avioanele, dronele și navele militare pe măsură ce își reduc contribuția la NATO
lithuania.description: Statele Unite aşteaptă de la aliaţii europeni din NATO şi de la Canada să îşi crească rapid numărul de aparate de zbor cu şi fără pilot şi de nave militare cu care vor contribui la planurile de apărare ale Alianţei, pe măsură ce Washingtonul îşi retrage capacităţile în aceste domenii, a indicat miercuri generalul american Alexus Grynkewich, comandantul suprem al Forţelor aliate din Europa (SACEUR), transmite Reuters.

lithuania.title: Zelenski anunță că Ucraina va trimite experți antidrone în România și statele baltice
lithuania.description: Preşedintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski a anunţat miercuri, la o conferinţă de presă comună la Kiev cu secretarul general al NATO Mark Rutte, că Ucraina va trimite grupuri de experţi în apărare aeriană antidrone în România şi în statele baltice pentru a le ajuta să îşi protejeze teritoriul în faţa incursiunilor dronelor folosite în războiul ruso-ucrainean.

lithuania.title: Mark Rutte, vizită-surpriză la Kiev: „Un gest de solidaritate şi de sprijin din partea Alianţei față de țara noastră”
lithuania.description: Secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, a sosit miercuri la Kiev pentru o vizită surpriză, a anunţat compania feroviară ucraineană Ukrzaliznytsia, transmit AFP şi Reuters.

lithuania.title: Criza iraniană schimbă calculele de securitate: „NATO devine tot mai relevantă”, spune fostul consilier al lui Trump
lithuania.description: NATO devine din ce în ce mai importantă pe măsură ce Europa se confruntă cu riscuri de securitate crescânde din partea Iranului, a declarat fostul consilier pentru securitate națională al SUA, John Bolton, într-un interviu acordat TVP World. El a avertizat că activitățile Iranului și capacitățile sale în materie de rachete ar putea amenința direct Europa și nu ar trebui considerate doar o preocupare a SUA. Bolton a criticat, de asemenea, lipsa de coordonare a Washingtonului cu aliații și a afirmat că incertitudinea privind strategia SUA în Orientul Mijlociu ar putea avea implicații mai ample pentru securitatea globală, inclusiv pentru Ucraina.

lithuania.title: USR: Coaliţia dintre PSD şi extremiştii proruşi, vot împotriva includerii magistraților în categoria avertizorilor de integritate
lithuania.description: Reprezentanţii USR acuză că senatorii PSD şi partidelor „extremiste proruse” au votat împotriva includerii judecătorilor şi procurorilor în categoria avertizorilor de integritate. „Un sistem în care chiar cei din interior nu sunt protejaţi atunci când semnalează nereguli transmite un mesaj negativ societăţii: că transparenţa şi responsabilitatea nu sunt pe deplin asumate. Se menţine o ambiguitate juridică periculoasă”, afirmă senatorul USR Simona Spătaru.

lithuania.title: Senatul a respins alegerea primarilor în două tururi. AUR și USR au votat pentru, PSD și PNL au fost împotriva proiectului
lithuania.description: Senatul a respins, marți, proiectul de lege inițiat de parlamentari AUR care prevedea revenirea la alegerea primarilor și a președinților de consilii județene în două tururi de scrutin. Inițiativa a fost susținută de senatorii AUR, Pace-Întâi România și USR, însă a fost respinsă de PSD, PNL și UDMR, astfel că nu a întrunit numărul necesar de voturi pentru a fi adoptată.

lithuania.title: Șoșoacă apără Rusia în cazul dronei de la Galați, în direct la televiziunea Kremlinului: „Ne puteți ataca și azi, și mâine”
lithuania.description: Preșdinta S.O.S România, Diana Șoșoacă, a avut o intervenție la televiziunea Russia Today, după ce o dronă rusească a lovit un bloc din Galați, în timpul căreia a acuzat NATO și Uniunea Europeană că vor să forțeze țara noastră să atace Rusia. Mai mult, aceasta ia apărarea Kremlinului, afirmând că cel mai probabil Ucraina e de vină pentru incident.

lithuania.title: „Ca un boa constrictor”. Rusia critică exercițiul militar din Serbia la care participă opt țări NATO, printre care și România
lithuania.description: Purtătoarea de cuvânt a Ministerului de externe al Rusiei, Maria Zaharova, a criticat exercițiul anual „Platinum Wolf” din Serbia, acuzând NATO că încearcă să subjuge Serbia „ca un boa constrictor”, a transmis Reuters. Reprezentanta diplomației ruse susține că NATO vrea să preia controlul asupra Balcanilor și să îndepărteze Serbia de Rusia. „Își încolăcesc iubirea în …

lithuania.title: Franța acuză „provocări” după ce a ridicat de 11 ori într-o săptămână avioanele în zona Mării Baltice
lithuania.description: Avioane de luptă franceze au fost ridicate de 11 ori în ultima săptămână în cadrul misiunii NATO de Poliție Aeriană în Țările Baltice, a declarat joi purtătorul de cuvânt al armatei franceze, care a descris aceste incidente drept un număr mai mare decât de obicei de „provocări”, notează Reuters. Misiunea are rolul de a proteja …

lithuania.title: Estonia has no clarity on rotating US unit, minister says
lithuania.description: Estonia has no clarity on future U.S. troop rotations, Minister of Defense Hanno Pevkur (Reform) said on Wednesday, after it was reported that Lithuania does not know when its American forces will be replaced.

lithuania.title: Rootsi kohus käskis arestida Vene varilaevastiku aluse
lithuania.description: Rootsi kohus otsustas täna Ukraina palve järel arestida sanktsioonide alla kuuluva Vene varilaevastiku aluse Caffa, vahendab Kyiv Independent.

lithuania.title: Baltic parliamentarians will enjoy Friday in Liepāja
lithuania.description: On Friday, June 5th, at a joint meeting of the Baltic Assembly (BA) Committees on Natural Resources and Environment and on Health, Welfare and Family Affairs, parliamentarians from Latvia, Estonia and Lithuania will seek solutions for a more comprehensive harmonisation of climate and health policies in the Baltic States, as well as discuss the implementation of joint measures to mitigate the impact of climate change on human health.

lithuania.title: Baltics, Nordics, USA discuss NATO summit
lithuania.description: On 1–2 June 2026, the regular meeting of the E-PINE (Enhanced Partnership in Northern Europe) format took place in Tallinn and Narva, Estonia, bringing together representatives of the Baltic States, the Nordic countries, and the United States of America (USA). Latvia was represented by Juris Poikāns, Ambassador-at-Large, according to a release from the Latvian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

lithuania.title: Putins cenšas pārliecināt pasauli, ka Ukraina nevar uzvarēt. NATO eksperts atklāj, kāpēc tā nav taisnība
lithuania.description: Krievijas diktators Vladimirs Putins konsekventi veido tēlu, ka Ukrainai nav izredžu uzvarēt, tāpēc Rietumu stratēģiskais uzdevums ir skaidri paust pretējo, vērtēja bijušais NATO ģenerālsekretāra vietnieks izlūkošanas un drošības jautājumos, konsultāciju uzņēmuma “Ironhelm Works” dibinātājs Deivids Ketlers. Konferences “Riga StratCom Dialogue” diskusijā Ketlers akcentēja, ka šāda tēla veidošanā Putins, iespējams, izmanto refleksīvo kontroli, proti, pretinieks apzināti […]

lithuania.title: Lapiņš pēc vizītes Ukrainā: Boroģankā redzētās patvertnes ir praktisks piemērs arī Latvijai
lithuania.description: Rīgas domes Drošības un civilās aizsardzības komitejas vadītājs Ģirts Lapiņš kopā ar Rīgas vicemēru Eduardu Ratnieku šonedēļ apmeklējis Ukrainu, kur piedalījies Ukrainas prezidenta Volodimira Zelenska organizētā konferencē. lithuania.title: Krimā okupantiem kļūst arvien “karstāk”, jo ukraiņiem ir tikai viens mērķis un viņi dara visu, lai to sasniegtu
lithuania.description: Krimā situācija Krievijas spēkiem kļūst arvien sarežģītāka, jo Ukraina turpina meklēt jaunus veidus, kā apdraudēt okupantu militāro infrastruktūru, tostarp aviācijas bāzes. lithuania.title: Slaidiņš: Krievi Konstantinivku mēģina nolīdzināt līdz pamatiem, bet pilsētas aizstāvji joprojām turas
lithuania.description: Konstantinivkas virzienā situācija joprojām ir smaga, un Krievijas spēki turpina izmantot sev ierasto taktiku — masīvus artilērijas un aviācijas triecienus, cenšoties pilsētu pakāpeniski pārvērst drupās. Par to TV24 stāsta Jānis Slaidiņš, NBS majors, Zemessardzes štāba virsnieks. Pēc Slaidiņa teiktā, Ukrainas puse ziņo, ka pilsēta tiek nolīdzināta līdz pamatiem. lithuania.title: Putins panikā: ukraiņu droni “paralizē” Sanktpēterburgu – deg viens no lielākajiem naftas termināliem
lithuania.description: Krievijā Sanktpēterburgā naktī uz trešdienu pēc Ukrainas dronu trieciena aizdedzies naftas terminālis, vēsta “Astra” un citi “Telegram” kanāli. Triecienu veikšanu Sanktpēterburgas naftas terminālim apstiprināja arī Ukrainas pārstāvji. Trieciena rezultātā izraisījies ugunsgrēks uzņēmumā “Pēterburgas naftas terminālis”, kas ir viens no lielākajiem naftas pārstrādes kompleksiem Krievijas ziemeļrietumos, vēsta “Astra”. lithuania.title: FOTO. Aizvadīta ļoti traģiska nakts Ukrainā – notikuši masīvi triecieni vairākos apgabalos, daudz ievainoto un bojāgājušo, izsludinātas sēras

Aizvadītajā diennaktī masīviem triecieniem pakļauti Sumu un Hersonas apgabali, kur ir bojāgājušie un ievainotie, tostarp bērni, vēsta Dialog.UA.
